Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/01/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 141 as introduced further expands the provisions of law that currently allows the issuance of professional licenses and certificates for spouses of military personnel, to now include spouses of employees of the U.S. Department of Justice and subordinate agencies, and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, that are relocated to Alabama by order of their employer. This bill will further reduce potential receipts to boards, agencies, commissions, and other entities that issue professional licenses or certificates by a small undetermined amount dependent upon the number of additional individuals that benefit from the provisions of this act.
Tom Butler, Chairperson
Veterans and Military Affairs

Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/22/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 141 as passed the Senate could reduce potential receipts to various professional licensing boards by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of fees waived for spouses of employees of the U.S. Department of Justice and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration that seek reciprocal licensure pursuant to the provisions of the bill.
Dickie Drake, Chair
Military and Veterans Affairs
